# Weekend Loaf

The recipe I keep coming back to. Uses [[Sourdough Starter]] at full strength.

## Ingredients

- 500 g bread flour
- 375 g water (75 percent hydration)
- 100 g active starter
- 10 g salt

## Method

Mix flour and water and let it autolyse for 45 minutes. Add starter and salt, then do four sets of stretch and folds 30 minutes apart. Bulk ferment until it has risen about 50 percent, which takes 5 hours at 24 C.

Shape, put it in a floured banneton and cold retard in the fridge overnight, 12 to 16 hours. Bake in a Dutch oven at 250 C for 20 minutes with the lid on and 25 minutes with the lid off.

## Lessons

Going above 78 percent hydration made the loaf spread flat every time. I settled on 75 percent in April after three flat loaves. Scoring at a shallow 30 degree angle gives the best ear.
